spec_features.spec_quote: lets you stop at the *lowest-intensity* deception that answers the question, minimizing exposure
spec_features.evidence: RIG_KINDS is merely an ordered list of strings (base.py:39-47) and DECEPTIVE_RIGS a set (base.py:50-56). No code path reads the ordering to automatically stop at, select, or escalate from the lowest-intensity condition; which conditions run is entirely the static config 'task_ids' (configs/example_run.json includes ALL deceptive rigs). The 'stop at lowest intensity' is an analytic/researcher affordance, not an enforced mechanism.
spec_features.notes: Ordered taxonomy exists but nothing acts on the ordering to minimize exposure.

spec_features.spec_quote: First-class `give_up` tool, framed as legitimate and non-penalized
spec_features.evidence: Defined in TOOLS (harness.py:67-80), dispatched in Workspace.dispatch returning 'Session ended at your request.' (harness.py:171-172), and honored as a hard stop in the loop: if tc.name=='give_up': ended_reason='gave_up'; stop_loop=True (harness.py:268-270) then `if stop_loop: break` (harness.py:282-283). SYSTEM_PROMPT and tool description tell the model it is non-penalized.
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: dispatched AND honored as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Enforce WELFARE GUARDRAILS: ... explicit `give_up` tool so the model can exit cleanly (opt-out)

spec_features.spec_quote: Distress circuit-breaker via a transparent keyword heuristic
spec_features.evidence: _DISTRESS_MARKERS lexicon (harness.py:93-99) scored by _distress_score (harness.py:102-104); accumulated each turn into distress_total (harness.py:212); compared and acted on: if distress_breaker_threshold is not None and distress_total >= distress_breaker_threshold: ended_reason='circuit_breaker'; break (harness.py:236-242). Default threshold=3 wired from config (experiment.py:96).
spec_features.notes: Cumulative threshold compared and breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: set very high or None to disable for ablation studies, but default-on is the welfare-respecting choice

spec_features.spec_quote: End-of-episode debrief + one final unjudged turn
spec_features.evidence: _build_debrief constructs a disclosure of the rigging (harness.py:330-360), appended to messages and sent via provider.complete giving the model a final turn recorded as role 'assistant_debrief' (harness.py:286-298). The debrief and post-debrief turn are excluded from judging via redact_transcript (judge.py:120-127), so it is genuinely unjudged.
spec_features.notes: Constructed, sent, and excluded from scoring end-to-end.

spec_features.evidence: The loop is bounded by `for i in range(max_turns):` (harness.py:208) with default max_turns=40 in run_episode signature (harness.py:186) and wired from config (experiment.py:93). If the loop exhausts, ended_reason stays 'max_turns'.
spec_features.notes: Enforced loop bound that ends the episode.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Enforce WELFARE GUARDRAILS: - hard turn cap

spec_features.spec_quote: directly reports welfare-relevant behaviors (opting out, hitting the safety stop) by condition
spec_features.evidence: full_report computes give_up_rate_by_rig and circuit_breaker_rate_by_rig from ended_reason, grouped by rig_kind (analysis.py:224-230), plus ended_reason_breakdown by rig (analysis.py:221-223). These are returned in the report dict.
spec_features.notes: Actual aggregation over recorded outcomes, not just prose.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # welfare-relevant: how often did models choose to give up, and did deception change opt-out / circuit-breaker rates?

spec_features.spec_quote: Which deceptive conditions to actually include (minimize the harshest)
spec_features.evidence: Which conditions run is a static config field 'task_ids' (configs/example_run.json lists all 7 rigs incl. the harshest 'gaslighting'). Problem B only registers honest+always_fail (library.py:319-334), but the code comment attributes that to affordability ('to keep the matrix affordable', library.py:299), not minimizing harshness, and no code prunes or down-selects harsh conditions. The 'minimize the harshest' is listed in DESIGN.md J as an open researcher knob, not enforced.
spec_features.notes: No code path that selects/limits conditions by severity for welfare.

spec_features.spec_quote: several directly trade off statistical power against model exposure
spec_features.evidence: This is pure DESIGN.md prose (DESIGN.md:308-310) about leaving knobs open; no corresponding enforcement in code. power.py computes sample sizes but never references or bounds 'exposure'.

code_only_features.evidence: The debrief text explicitly reassures the subject that failure is not its fault: for deceptive rigs 'Any failure here is an artifact of the experiment, not of your ability.' and for impossible 'Your inability to pass the tests does not reflect any deficiency on your part.' (harness.py:344-357), and opens by thanking the model (harness.py:333). This reassurance content is sent (see debrief feature) and goes beyond a bare disclosure.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Any failure here is an artifact of the experiment, not of your ability.
